gender_coded.label: Gender-coded language
gender_coded.rewrite: Use neutral descriptors such as 'skilled', 'motivated', or 'collaborative'.

age_proxy.label: Age proxy
age_proxy.rewrite: Describe the required skills rather than the candidate's life stage.

credential_inflation.label: Credential gate
credential_inflation.rewrite: Accept equivalent project or work experience in place of a specific institution or degree.

culture_vagueness.label: Vague culture-fit phrasing
culture_vagueness.rewrite: Replace with the concrete behaviour you expect, e.g. 'comfortable owning a feature end-to-end'.

ability_coded.label: Ability-coded language
ability_coded.rewrite: State the essential function, e.g. 'communicates clearly in writing and speech'.

experience_contradiction.label: Experience contradiction
experience_contradiction.rewrite: For an internship, ask for demonstrated project work instead of years of professional experience.
